passives.name: Insatiable Curiosity
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When an enemy performs an action, if the caster is inflicted with Shocked, reduces Priority of all allies by 10%. Every time an ally is killed, increases the cooldown of Bless All Mages by 3 turns, and reduces Attack and Defense of the caster by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_monster_2000028_4_2] each. (Max 3 stacks) Greatly reduces damage taken by all allies from attacks that target all enemies. At the end of the caster's turn, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000025_4_2].
